design system: tokens, component library and Web Components for embeddable shop UI, tightly aligned with Product Design Create an AI-first prototyping and contribution framework – design system, AI architecture, design-system leadership and enablement What success looks like After 90 days: frontend audit of both products done, target architecture and migration roadmap agreed, design-system tokens and core components live, and the first prototype built and shipped by a product manager or designer on the new framework After 12 months: both products run on the shared design system, the years in frontend or software engineering, including 3+ years at Staff, Lead or Architect level – setting technical direction across teams, not just within your own Hands-on today: you write production code yourself – this is not a concept-only architect position Business-fluent English (C1); no formal degree required, your track record counts Nice-to-have Technical leadership without line management: you've led a SaaS frontend team through a major technology change Meta-frameworks such as Next.js and/or Astro – and a clear view on when to use which Design-to-code and prototyping tooling: Figma workflows, design-token pipelines, AI UI generation (v0, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling) eCommerce, search or product discovery frontends (search UIs, embeddable shop widgets) Enablers who enjoy making product managers and designers productive and treat them as peers Probably not for you if you'd rather produce architecture concepts than running code, want to go deep on one product and leave the cross-product system to others, or are looking for a people-management role. THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US What we offer Real ownership with executive backing: you shape the frontend of two products end to end. You report to our VP Engineering; our CPTO is the executive sponsor of this role – both agree the target architecture and migration roadmap with you, and the CPTO reviews your 90-day goals and holds your final interview. A company-level priority, not a side project AI-first as a leadership priority, with the tooling budget to match: Claude Code, Cursor or whatever makes you fastest Impact without switching to management: a Staff/Principal IC track on our career ladder toward Principal/Distinguished – with the option to move into engineering management later if you want to A product trio culture: engineering, product and design as co-owners, outcomes over outputs Competitive compensation that reflects the Staff level of this role Training and conference budget, 30 days of vacation, modern equipment, mobility offers and a company pension plan Hybrid work with 2–3 office days per week in Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm How we hire Remote, with feedback within 48 hours after every step: 1. 30-minute intro call with our Recruiter Mirko 2. 60-minute technical interview with our VP Engineering (your future manager) and an engineering lead: one frontend modernization you led, your design-system story, and how you use AI day to day 3. Is "AI-first" real here, or a buzzword? It's driven by our CPTO and part of the career ladder for every engineer. Why eCommerce search? Because agentic commerce is where AI meets real purchase decisions – on our platform that's 2,000+ shops and €160+ billion in GMV a year.
